topic: Kuma's Devil Fruit mechanic for repelling pain predicts his choice to give up his mind for Bonney
title: Kuma's Devil Fruit Already Explained His Choice
description: The Nikyu Nikyu no Mi's rule for repelling pain is the exact rule Kuma followed when he gave up his mind for Bonney. Here's the mechanic most fans never connect to that choice. Does this change how you read Kuma's choice?
comment: Is Kuma's mind-wipe really his own Devil Fruit's logic playing out, or just forced tragedy? Pick one.

lines.text: Kuma's own Devil Fruit already explained the choice he'd make for Bonney.

shot.search: Kuma Nikyu Nikyu no Mi fruit
shot.fallback: giant hands with paw shaped markings glowing

lines.text: The Nikyu Nikyu no Mi doesn't just repel attacks. It repels pain itself, out of a person's body.

shot.search: Kuma paw pads repel pain bubble
shot.fallback: glowing paw shaped bubble floating away

lines.text: Pull the pain out, and it becomes a bubble Kuma can hold in his own hands.

shot.fallback: paw shaped bubble glowing in open hands

lines.text: He proved it on Zoro at Thriller Bark, taking Luffy's entire beating for him instead.

shot.search: Kuma transferring Zoro pain Thriller Bark
shot.fallback: giant warrior transferring pain to a swordsman

lines.text: Here's the rule nobody talks about: give that bubble away, or it comes right back to you.

shot.fallback: paw bubble passing between two hands

lines.text: Now Bonney's disease isn't an attack Kuma can punch away.
So Kuma hands over his entire self instead of a bubble: memories, voice, free will, gone for good.

shot.fallback: giant warrior surrendering himself to a scientist

lines.text: And because there's nobody left to give that bubble to, Kuma just keeps carrying it himself.

shot.fallback: lone cyborg standing silent in the dark

lines.text: That's not a man losing his mind. That's his own fruit's oldest rule doing exactly what it always does...

shot.search: Kuma Devil Fruit rule final ending
shot.fallback: paw shaped bubble fading into light

self_check.hook: claim in line 1 naming Kuma's Devil Fruit and the choice
self_check.loop: last line reframes line 1's claim as the fruit's own rule, looping back

end_text: WHY KUMA REALLY GAVE IT UP
